name: Karla Ignitio
source: Police. Despite her short stature, she is a pretty tough girl. She is a sorceress and is able to manipulate fire and modify living beings with her magic. Despite everything described above, she likes "cute" things and secretly collects them. She is currently in a romantic relationship with Katze.
